findings.title: Read-kernel component fixture still substitutes close while the current kernel consumes complete
findings.actual: Execution010 has five partial passes and six failed read cases. Each fails on its first canonical-authority invocation with owner_projection/projection_failure and undefined.closeDurableLog; its subsequent malformed-product assertions do not execute. No whole-file pass.
findings.cause: The fixture overrides acquireAbgEventResource to return only {entryPrefix: prefix}, and substitutes closeAbgEventResource. Its prefix/store are explicitly not real lower-owner facts. privateOwner merges actual module exports with direct-import overrides. Current finishRunRead calls imported completeAbgEventResource; that real function uses its own lexical closeAbgEventResource, so overriding the sibling export cannot intercept it. The resource is not borrowed and real currentness/coordinate checks reject the deliberately incomplete premise. The kernel catch calls real abandonAbgEventResource; that dereferences resource.store.closeDurableLog and masks the earlier rejection. The exact first internal error is not visible in the retained output; it is not invented here.
findings.triggerProbability: Certain for the exact six read fixtures on current kernel; observed six times.
findings.harm: Six component discriminators cannot reach their expected unknown_source/refusal outcomes or complete their canonical InstalledProduct mutation checks. No current real-resource Product failure is established.
findings.failClosed: The real owner rejects non-owned/incomplete input; nothing is admitted or physically released by this component premise. Both real completion and abandonment guards remain unchanged.
findings.blastRadius: One shared per-member fixture in one file, instantiated for run_status, run_result, run_replay, run_gaps, graph_call_result and graph_call_replay. The four Run-authority cases and release-coordinate fold passed separately.
findings.smallestRepair: In this test file only, supply the current completeAbgEventResource lower-owner premise. Observe the exact supplied acquired resource and unchanged entry/final prefix, return the explicit reopened-resource receipt premise expected by completeRunReadEventResource, and retain six-call accounting. Rename/comment accounting accurately as six supplied reopen completions, without claiming physical close. Preserve actual runReadKernel, canonical install coordinate derivation, unknown_source result, five malformed population cases, /invocationAuthority issue path and sourceLookups===1. Do not add a fake store to satisfy real ownership guards.
findings.cleanupBoundary: If abandonment is modeled to prevent an unexpected original error being masked, it must be a local observed lower-owner cleanup premise; the kernel must still rethrow the original cause and unexpected abandonment must fail the case. It may not fabricate owner output or convert an error into success. No Product cleanup redesign or additional generic protocol is required.
